name: lisachenko/userland-php-generics
description: Reified generics for PHP: templates monomorphized into real class entries by the Zend Engine

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the test suite (destructive internal group excluded)
scripts-descriptions.test:internal: Run the destructive class-table eviction group; a debug build additionally reports leaks
scripts-descriptions.bench: Measure the cost of monomorphization and rewrite docs/benchmarks.md
scripts-descriptions.bench:smoke: Run every benchmark scenario at a tiny size so it cannot bit-rot
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run static analysis at the maximum level
scripts-descriptions.test:analysis: Run the PHPStan extension tests, which need no engine
scripts-descriptions.stubs:generate: Regenerate the committed PHPStan stubs for the placeholder-form templates
scripts-descriptions.stubs:check: Fail if the committed PHPStan stubs no longer match the generator
scripts-descriptions.test:preload: Boot preload.php in a child process; must run, never silently skip
